title: Learning Topology-Aware Representations for Mechanics-Relevant TPMS Metamaterials
abstract: arXiv:2610.20684v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learning informative representations of mechanical Triply Periodic Minimal Surface (TPMS) metamaterials is important for mechanics analysis and structural design, yet existing methods have rarely explicitly supervised learned representations with information about global structural connectivity that is relevant to mechanical response. We propose a topology-aware representation learning framework that integrates persistent homology into a DMAE backbone to explicitly encode global structural connectivity. A persistence-guided masking strategy prioritizes patches associated with persistent topological features, while an auxiliary persistent-homology decoder encourages the latent representation to retain information about topological feature counts across connected components, tunnels, and voids. translated_title: 面向力学相关TPMS超材料的拓扑感知表示学习
translated_abstract: 学习力学三重周期极小曲面（TPMS）超材料的信息性表示对于力学分析和结构设计十分重要，然而现有方法很少利用与力学响应相关的全局结构连通性信息来显式监督所学习到的表示。我们提出了一种拓扑感知的表示学习框架，将持续同调融入DMAE骨干网络，以显式编码全局结构连通性。一种由持续性引导的掩码策略优先关注与持续拓扑特征相关的图像块，同时一个辅助的持续同调解码器促使潜在表示保留关于连通分量、隧道和空洞等拓扑特征数量的信息。我们在两个互补的TPMS数据集上，通过家族分类、力学性能分类、无监督等任务评估了所学习到的表示。
tldr: 提出将持续同调融入DMAE骨干网络的拓扑感知表示学习框架，通过持续性引导的掩码策略和辅助持续同调解码器显式编码TPMS超材料的全局结构连通性，从而更好地支持力学分析与结构设计。
en_tdlr: A topology-aware representation learning framework integrates persistent homology into a DMAE backbone, using persistence-guided masking and an auxiliary persistent-homology decoder to explicitly encode global structural connectivity of mechanics-relevant TPMS metamaterials.
